Infrastructure: give the conformance runner a way to consume recorded manual-review verdicts — every manual-evidenced assertion (mdn-coverage-accurate, mobile/desktop legibility, guidance review) reports 'blocked: manual-pending' by design even when the writer's review evidence exists in the critique, so the committed rollup can never show those checks as resolved (Codex rounds 23/25, PR #7). A per-page manual-evidence sidecar (assertion id -> verdict + evidence pointer + date) consumed by scripts/conformance.mjs would let genuine reviews convert blocked to an evidenced verdict while keeping unreviewed assertions blocked. scripts/ is off-limits to the routine.
